registry_objects.summary: A spinor configuration psi is sigma_A-admissible iff psi in Gamma_L (left-handed). Right-handed configurations have sigma*(psi_R) = -psi_R, destroying phase matching at omega.

registry_objects.title: Crossing-Point Mode Classification
registry_objects.summary: At crossing point p_ω, fibre excitations decompose by spin: J=0 (one real scalar, σ-even, neutral), J=1 (pair of vector modes with definite polarity and nonzero charge), J≥2 (absent — wedge point lacks 2D tangent space).

registry_objects.title: Discrete Hessian Spectrum
registry_objects.summary: Sequence {lambda_1^(n)} is monotonically decreasing and bounded below, converging to lambda_1 > 0 (refinement-stable). Full limiting spectrum is discrete. Strict positivity excludes fourth flat direction.

registry_objects.title: Positive gap at each stage
registry_objects.summary: For each n >= n_* the positive gap mu_1^(n) > 0 holds: by (KH-3), Q_n(p,p) > 0 for all nontrivial p, and the minimum of a finite set of positive numbers is positive. In continuum QFT the analogous infimum need not be attained.

registry_objects.title: Vacuum coherence
registry_objects.summary: Vacuum coherence: for all n >= n_*, the restriction rho_{n+1->n}(Omega_{n+1}^*) = Omega_n^*, established by restriction preserving admissibility and optimality, paralleling the strong vacuum truncation coherence theorem.

registry_objects.title: Excitation coherence
registry_objects.summary: Excitation coherence: for all n >= n_*, rho(h_{n+1}) = h_n, because restriction maps perturbations to perturbations, excitation cost is non-decreasing under restriction by (KH-2), and surjectivity (KH-1) prevents strict improvement.

registry_objects.title: Winding Preservation
registry_objects.summary: Winding Preservation Lemma: any admissible endomorphism phi in HolEnd_tau compatible with the C-sector preserves the total eta-winding class modulo 3, ensuring baryon number conservation under all physically realizable processes.

registry_objects.title: Finite-stage spectral problem
registry_objects.summary: At each stage n >= n_0, Q_n is a symmetric non-negative bilinear form on R^{|P_n(U)|} with finite spectrum 0 = mu_0^(n) <= mu_1^(n) <= ... <= mu_{d_n}^(n), establishing the finite-dimensional spectral problem from which the gap is extracted.

registry_objects.summary: A CR-structure (H, J) is integrable if and only if the Nijenhuis tensor N_J vanishes on H. Equivalent to Lie bracket closure of Gamma(H^{1,0}).

registry_objects.title: Integrability of τ³ CR-Structure
registry_objects.summary: The CR-structure (H, J, ν) on τ³ is integrable. Follows from the torus fiber T² carrying a globally flat complex structure: coordinate vector fields commute and N_J vanishes identically on H.

registry_objects.title: Density Halving
registry_objects.summary: Λ_CR has density 1/2 in Z². The CR parity constraint eliminates exactly half the naive mode space.

registry_objects.title: Higgs sector satisfies (KH-1)--(KH-3)
registry_objects.summary: The Higgs sector satisfies all three kernel hypotheses: (KH-1) stabilization at n_* = 2 (primorial depth of B), (KH-2) weak curvature defect is refinement-monotone, and (KH-3) discrete Hessian spectrum lemma gives lambda_1 > 0 after Goldstone absorption.

registry_objects.title: Strong sector as τ-holonomy sector
registry_objects.summary: The strong sector defines a tau-holonomy sector S_s via C_n = admissible strong connections G_n on the hadronic torus T(H)[n], with chi_minus-preservation and the strong defect functional Delta_n^s.

registry_objects.title: Strong sector kernel hypotheses
registry_objects.summary: Strong sector kernel hypotheses: (KH-1) stabilization at n_* = 3 (C-sector activation depth), (KH-2) Delta_n^s is refinement-monotone since L_s[n] subset L_s[n+1], and (KH-3) is deferred to ch41 requiring confinement and color holonomy.

registry_objects.title: Equivalence of defect formulations
registry_objects.summary: The plaquette-aggregated defect V_n^s and the gap-loop defect Delta_n^s determine the same vacuum: argmin of V_n^s over Adm_s[n] equals Gamma_s^*[n], because every gap loop decomposes into plaquettes and the aggregations are equivalent.

registry_objects.title: Refinement coherence
registry_objects.summary: Refinement coherence: the restriction map rho from C_s[n+1] to C_s[n] satisfies rho(Gamma_s^*[n+1]) = Gamma_s^*[n] for all n >= n_* = 3, the C-sector activation depth, ensuring the plaquette-form vacuum is consistent across stages.

registry_objects.title: Properties of Q_n^s
registry_objects.summary: Properties of Q_n^s: symmetric (Q_n^s(p,q) = Q_n^s(q,p)), non-negative with equality iff p is gauge-equivalent to the vacuum, finite rank (finite-dimensional configuration space), providing the spectral data for the mass gap.

registry_objects.title: Gap mode coherence
registry_objects.summary: Gap mode coherence: for all n >= 3 beyond stabilization, the restriction map satisfies rho(g_{n+1}) = g_n, ensuring the lightest excitation modes at successive stages are consistent and the projective limit g[omega] is well-defined.

registry_objects.title: Gap positivity at each finite stage
registry_objects.summary: Gap positivity at each finite stage: for every n >= 3, delta_n^s > 0, because C_s[n] is finite, Q_n^s is positive-definite on non-vacuum perturbations, and the minimum of a finite set of positive eigenvalues is positive.

registry_objects.title: Tower monotonicity
registry_objects.summary: Tower monotonicity: delta_{n+1}^s >= delta_n^s for all n >= 3, so the spectral gap is non-decreasing along the refinement tower. Higher refinement strengthens admissibility constraints, increasing the energy cost of any excitation.

registry_objects.title: No primitive mixing
registry_objects.summary: No primitive mixing: alpha_s^* is distinct from alpha_em^* and alpha_wk^*; no tau-admissible endomorphism intertwines Fix(s) with Fix(EM) or Fix(wk), because the fixed-point subalgebras intersect only at iota_tau (which is not a derived coupling).

registry_objects.title: Characters on T²
registry_objects.summary: A character on T² is determined by (m,n) ∈ Z×Z via χ_{m,n}(θ_γ,θ_η) = exp(i(mθ_γ + nθ_η)). m = γ-winding (Radials), n = η-winding (Beacons).

registry_objects.title: The argmin is the π-lift
registry_objects.summary: The argmin of the combined defect Delta_pi[n](x) over admissible pi-typed endomorphisms A_pi[n] equals the pi-lift Lift_pi(n) for all n >= 3, verifying that the canonical construction coincides with the variational characterization.

registry_objects.title: Λ_QCD as readout saturation
registry_objects.summary: Lambda_QCD is the energy at which the readout functor R_C(mu^2) ceases to be injective on the boundary algebra; below this scale multiple distinct boundary states project to the same measured value, and the readout loses information (readout saturation).

registry_objects.title: Asymptotic freedom as spectral tightening
registry_objects.summary: Asymptotic freedom as spectral tightening: at high energy scales (mu >> Lambda_QCD), the C-sector readout satisfies R_C(mu^2) < 1 and decreases with increasing mu, because chi_minus-dominant characters tighten under deeper refinement.

registry_objects.title: Quark electric charges
registry_objects.summary: Quark electric charges are determined by color class: d-type quarks (n equiv 1 mod 3) have Q = -1/3 e, u-type quarks (n equiv 2 mod 3) have Q = +2/3 e, arising from the ternary eta-circle structure and the crossing coupling omega.

registry_objects.title: Generation mass ordering
registry_objects.summary: Generation mass ordering: breathing eigenvalues satisfy lambda_crossing < lambda_single-lobe < lambda_full-L, yielding the mass hierarchies m_u < m_c < m_t and m_d < m_s < m_b. Scope: conjectural (quantitative spectrum deferred to Part VII).

registry_objects.title: Gluon count
registry_objects.summary: The strong sector admits exactly 8 independent connection modes corresponding to the 8 generators of su(3): dim_R su(3) = 3^2 - 1 = 8, each basis element corresponding to a gluon type as an independent gauge boson.

registry_objects.title: Gluon self-interaction vertices

registry_objects.title: omega-Germ Normalizer Norm_omega

registry_objects.title: Admissible Endomorphism Monoid HolEnd^adm_tau

registry_objects.title: Cosmic Stack API

registry_objects.title: Clopen frame
registry_objects.summary: A clopen frame at depth n is a pair (U_k^(n), e_k^(n)) where U_k^(n) = [alpha_k, alpha_{k+1}] is the k-th clopen arc of tau^1 and e_k^(n) = (e_gamma, e_eta, e_omega) is a coherence basis for the fiber T^2 over that arc.

registry_objects.title: Frame holonomy on tau^1
registry_objects.summary: The frame holonomy at depth n is the composition Hol_n = Phi_{p_n-1,0}^(n) circ ... circ Phi_{0,1}^(n) of all frame adjacency maps around the base circle tau^1, yielding an element of Aut(T^2_{alpha_0}).

registry_objects.title: Holonomy gap element
registry_objects.summary: The local gap element Delta_k^(n) = Phi_{k,k+1}^(n) - Id_{T^2} in End(T^2_{alpha_{k+1}}) measures the per-arc deviation from flatness. The total gap element at depth n sums these local contributions over all p_n arcs.

registry_objects.title: Torus vacuum --- V.D01
registry_objects.summary: The torus vacuum is the stabilized torus configuration of tau^3 beyond the maturity horizon n*, characterized by the shape ratio r/R = iota_tau = 2/(pi+e). The shape ratio is fixed by refinement coherence; only the overall scale R remains free.

registry_objects.title: Gravitational constant --- V.D02
registry_objects.summary: The gravitational constant G_tau = (c^3/hbar) iota_tau^2 is the coherence conversion invariant translating between the tau-native D-sector coupling kappa(D;1) = 1 - iota_tau and the experimentally measured G. In Planck units, G_tau = iota_tau^2.

registry_objects.title: Gravitational coupling kappa_tau
registry_objects.summary: The gravitational coupling kappa_tau = kappa(D;1) = 1 - iota_tau approximately equals 0.658696. This is the unique depth-1 coupling in the D-sector and serves as the coefficient in the tau-Einstein equation.

registry_objects.title: Null intertwiner
registry_objects.summary: A null intertwiner is an element phi in H_partial[omega] whose temporal component (D-sector projection) and spatial component (fiber sector projection) satisfy ||pr_D(phi)||^2 = ||pr_fiber(phi)||^2 under the boundary character pairing.

registry_objects.title: Local tau^3 chart
registry_objects.summary: A local tau^3 chart is a readout functor R_p: H_partial[omega] -> O_p centered at a base point p in tau^1, where O_p is a Minkowski vector space of signature (1,3). The chart is valid in a neighborhood U_p of the base point.

registry_objects.title: Curvature character --- V.D04
registry_objects.summary: The curvature character R^H is the D-sector boundary projection of the frame holonomy gap: R^H_n(x) = eta_n(T^GR_n(x)) in H_partial^(D), where T^GR_n(x) is the minimal GR budget (smallest alpha-index) at base point x and depth n.

registry_objects.title: Matter character --- V.D03

registry_objects.title: tau-Einstein equation --- V.D06
registry_objects.summary: The tau-Einstein equation is the boundary-character identity R^H(x) = kappa_tau * T^mat(x) in H_partial[omega], where R^H is the curvature character, kappa_tau = 1-iota_tau is the gravitational coupling, and T^mat is the matter character. It is algebraic, not a PDE.

registry_objects.title: Linearized tau-Einstein equation

registry_objects.title: Gravitational wave in tau-framework
registry_objects.summary: A gravitational wave in the tau-framework is a propagating perturbation delta Delta_k^(n) of the holonomy gap elements satisfying the linearized tau-Einstein equation with T^mat_lin = 0 (vacuum perturbation).

registry_objects.title: Cocycle defect
registry_objects.summary: The cocycle defect Delta(chi) = G_omega(chi) - kappa_tau * T^mat_omega(chi) in H_partial[omega] measures how far a candidate boundary character chi departs from satisfying the tau-Einstein identity. A character is Einstein-admissible iff Delta(chi) = 0.

registry_objects.title: tau-NF Einstein iteration
registry_objects.summary: The tau-NF Einstein iteration is the sequence {chi_n} in H_partial[omega] starting from the linearized solution chi_{n_0}, with update chi_{n+1} = NF_omega(chi_n - lambda_n * Delta(chi_n)). The iteration terminates at depth n* when Delta(chi_{n*}) = 0 exactly.

registry_objects.title: Truncation-coherent descent
registry_objects.summary: The step size lambda_n in the NF Einstein iteration is truncation-coherent if it satisfies compatibility (truncation pi_n(chi_{n+1}) = chi_n) and monotonicity (the cocycle defect norm decreases at each step).

registry_objects.title: Density-saturated character

registry_objects.title: Null intertwiner

registry_objects.title: tau-Horizon

registry_objects.title: Torus vacuum --- V.D01

registry_objects.title: Gravitational constant --- V.D02

registry_objects.summary: Geometric relaxation is the process by which the torus vacuum adjusts its shape ratio toward r/R = iota_tau via the NF iteration. The geometric relaxation timescale t_geom ~ R_S / (c * (1-iota_tau)) is set by the gravitational sector coupling.

registry_objects.title: Topological relaxation

registry_objects.title: BH evolution modes --- V.D09

registry_objects.title: Spherical carrier predicate

registry_objects.title: Equilibrium carrier
registry_objects.summary: An equilibrium carrier is a boundary character chi satisfying the spherical carrier predicate Sph(chi), the stationarity condition rho(chi|_{tau^1}) = chi|_{tau^1} (no evolution along the alpha-orbit), and the tau-Einstein identity.

registry_objects.title: GR tension functional
registry_objects.summary: The GR tension functional T[chi] = sum_{n >= n_0} iota_tau^n ||G_omega(chi)|_n - G_omega(chi_flat)|_n||_n^2 measures the total deviation of a configuration from the flat torus vacuum, weighted by iota_tau^n at each orbit depth.

registry_objects.title: Tension profile

registry_objects.title: Canonical star builder

registry_objects.title: Neutron node

registry_objects.title: Node density and confinement tension

registry_objects.title: EW-stable node

registry_objects.title: Chandrasekhar threshold
registry_objects.summary: The Chandrasekhar threshold n_Ch is the critical baryon count at which the star builder transitions from Star_n(A) (weak-sector support, white dwarf) to Star_n(C) (strong-sector support, neutron star) or Star_n(D) (gravitational self-support, black hole).

registry_objects.title: GR Tension Functional
registry_objects.summary: The GR tension functional for a TOV star configuration x with mass M and ball carrier B^3 is T_n(x) = sup_{y in partial B^3} ||G_n(y)|| / (||T^mat_n(y)|| + epsilon_n), measuring the curvature-to-matter ratio at the carrier boundary.

registry_objects.title: Coherence Horizon
registry_objects.summary: The coherence horizon M_n*(x) is the maximal mass index for which the GR tension functional remains bounded by the structural threshold Lambda_tau: M_n* = sup{M | T_n(x_M) <= Lambda_tau}. Beyond it, ball topology cannot accommodate a refinement-coherent solution.

registry_objects.title: Topology Crossing Event

registry_objects.title: Calibration Constant Xi_tau
registry_objects.summary: The tau-relative calibration constant Xi_tau = lim_{n->omega} M_n* / m_n^(tau) is the omega-germ ratio of the coherence horizon to the neutron mass index. Both are tau-native quantities; no SI units enter its definition.

registry_objects.title: Calibration Triangle

registry_objects.title: Ring Homomorphism Phi_p,n
registry_objects.summary: The ring homomorphism Phi_{p,n}: R_partial^(micro) -> R_partial^(meso) is the boundary-ring map Lift_D circ Scale_{Xi_tau^(NT)} circ Embed_{A->D}, connecting the proton-neutron mass split (micro vertex) to the TOV scale (meso vertex) through sector-coupling algebra.

registry_objects.summary: The gravitational closing identity is alpha_G = alpha^18 * (chi kappa_n / 2), where alpha_G = G m_n^2 / (hbar c) is the gravitational fine-structure constant, alpha is the EM fine-structure constant, kappa_n is the co-rotor coupling, and chi is the chirality factor.

registry_objects.title: Thermodynamic equilibrium---categorical
registry_objects.summary: Categorical thermodynamic equilibrium: a configuration omega_eq on tau^3 with vanishing defect entropy S_def[omega_eq] = 0, meaning all holomorphic continuations are structurally trivial -- no defect bundles, no non-holomorphic insertions, no physically resolvable disorder.

registry_objects.title: Coherence horizon
registry_objects.summary: Coherence horizon: the orbit depth n_coh = min{n in N : S_def(n) = 0} at which defect entropy first reaches zero; for n >= n_coh the configuration is in categorical equilibrium. Existence and finiteness guaranteed by the Global Defect Exhaustion Theorem.

registry_objects.title: Defect partition of paths
registry_objects.summary: Defect partition of paths: at orbit depth n, CR-compatible paths of length <= r from node n are classified as defect-traversing (passing through at least one defect site where |dbar_b f| > 0) or defect-free (avoiding all defect sites in D_n).

registry_objects.title: Defect entropy
registry_objects.summary: Defect entropy at orbit depth n: S_def(n) = lim_{r->inf} (1/r) ln(1 + P_def(n,r)), measuring the exponential growth rate of defect-traversing paths; the +1 inside the logarithm ensures S_def = 0 when the defect path count vanishes (vacuum).

registry_objects.title: Refinement entropy
registry_objects.summary: Refinement entropy at orbit depth n: S_ref(n) = lim_{r->inf} (1/r) ln P_free(n,r), counting the exponential growth rate of defect-free holomorphic paths; these paths exist even in the vacuum because the lattice itself provides defect-free continuations.

registry_objects.title: Global defect budget
registry_objects.summary: Global defect budget: B_def = sum_{n=0}^{inf} |D_n|, the total defect support summed over all orbit depths, measuring the universe's total capacity for irreversible processes.

registry_objects.title: Coherence horizon---refined
registry_objects.summary: Coherence horizon (refined): n_coh = min{n in N : |D_n| = 0}, the smallest orbit depth at which the defect set is empty. By the Global Defect Exhaustion Theorem, this minimum exists and is finite; for p = 2 the bound gives n_coh <= 398.

registry_objects.title: Defect half-life

registry_objects.title: The asymmetry of falsification

registry_objects.title: The trigger is structural, not thermal

registry_objects.title: Two metrics, one space
registry_objects.summary: The base tau^1 carries two natural metrics -- an ultrametric encoding the hierarchical structure of the refinement tower (which levels share common coarse projections) and an additive time metric encoding physical temporal distance -- reflecting the dual roles of tau^1 as algebraic hierarchy and temporal substrate.

registry_objects.title: Minimal Alphabet and Sector Count

registry_objects.title: From Part V to Part VI

registry_objects.title: No ``hot'' or ``cold''
registry_objects.summary: Temperature is a chart-level readout concept requiring thermal equilibrium. At very early alpha-ticks, no meaningful thermal equilibrium exists. The language of "hot Big Bang" is a chart-level approximation accurate only after the first regime transitions.

registry_objects.title: Falsifiability

Apparent running in chart-level readouts is a projection artifact from coarse-graining the profinite structure.

In tau, no slow-roll is needed: regime invariance guarantees the same equation governs inflation, and exponential expansion follows from near-saturation boundary characters, not a flat potential.

registry_objects.title: Compactness vs. inflation
registry_objects.summary: Orthodox inflation solves the horizon problem dynamically (rapid expansion stretches a small region) requiring a specific inflaton mechanism. Tau-compactness solves it structurally: the universe is compact at all times, so causally disconnected regions never exist. The mechanism is geometric, not dynamical.

registry_objects.title: alpha_o and omega

The cosmological implications are developed in Part VI.

registry_objects.title: Sakharov Conditions
registry_objects.summary: Two of the three Sakharov conditions for baryogenesis are structural in tau: CP violation from the bipolar lemniscate, and departure from equilibrium from the directed alpha-orbit. Only baryon number violation remains open, reducing the mystery from three unknown mechanisms to one.

registry_objects.title: The lithium problem
registry_objects.summary: The cosmological lithium problem (discrepancy between predicted and observed primordial Li-7 abundance) is inherited by tau unchanged from standard BBN, because the nuclear physics is identical. Resolution requires modified nuclear cross sections or late-time depletion, not cosmological modification.

registry_objects.title: Event horizon as linking boundary
registry_objects.summary: The event horizon in tau is the linking boundary: the boundary of the T^2 region enclosed by the non-trivial linking class. Inside the linking boundary, the fiber topology is non-contractible; outside, it is contractible. This is the tau-native definition replacing the GR causal boundary.

registry_objects.title: Irreversibility of mergers
registry_objects.summary: The non-invertibility of the blueprint monoid is the algebraic expression of irreversibility of BH mergers. Two black holes can merge but cannot split back. This replaces Hawking's area increase theorem with a more fundamental algebraic statement: the monoid structure enforces merger irreversibility.

registry_objects.summary: The BH entropy formula becomes S_BH = k_B * A/(4*iota_tau^2), replacing the Planck length l_P^2 with iota_tau^2. registry_objects.summary: The blueprint monoid M_BH is the primary algebraic structure exported from Book V to Book VI (Categorical Life). In Book VI, it models metabolic processing (matter absorption as fusion), replication (blueprint copying), and structural memory (coherence tower persistence).

registry_objects.summary: The information paradox dissolves in tau because assumption (1) -- that black holes evaporate -- is false. There is no information loss because there is no evaporation. This is not a mechanism for information escape (Page, Maldacena, Penington) but a removal of the paradox's premise.

registry_objects.summary: The permanence hallmark is the key structural export from Book V to Book VI. In Book VI, the "alive" predicate for a BH-based system requires at least one permanence hallmark: a system without permanence is transient, not alive. Three items exported: No-Shrink, linking class, blueprint.

registry_objects.title: Why overlap forces merger
registry_objects.summary: In tau, BH mergers are topological: two excisions cannot coexist when their boundaries overlap, because the coherence kernel (axiom K3, injectivity of rho) forbids two distinct topological defects at the same refinement-tower location. Overlap forces coalescence, unlike the continuous GR dynamics.

registry_objects.title: What the Normal Form does not give
registry_objects.summary: The Merger Normal Form determines the final state and total radiated energy Delta_E but does not provide the time-domain gravitational waveform h(t). The waveform requires chart-level inspiral/plunge/ringdown dynamics. The Normal Form is topological; the waveform is dynamical.

registry_objects.title: No Background Time
registry_objects.summary: In Category tau the "problem of time" (Wheeler-DeWitt timelessness) does not arise: time is not a background parameter to be recovered from a timeless theory but IS the alpha-orbit. No external time parameter is postulated at any stage of the derivation chain from axioms to proper time.

registry_objects.title: The mass gap and the IMBH desert
registry_objects.summary: The primorial mass hierarchy predicts a natural gap in the BH mass spectrum between supermassive (10^6-10^10 M_sun) and stellar-mass (3-100 M_sun) black holes, with intermediate-mass BHs (10^2-10^5 M_sun) scarce. This is consistent with the observational IMBH desert.

Specific numerical predictions (peak locations) require calibrating primorial depths to SI mass scales via the full calibration cascade, which remains conjectural.

registry_objects.title: Contrast with the strong sector
registry_objects.summary: Gravity (base tau^1) is deconfined with perimeter-law Wilson loops, while the strong force (fiber T^2) is confined with area-law Wilson loops. This contrast is a direct dimensional consequence: tau^1 is 1D (no area), T^2 is 2D (area law possible).

registry_objects.title: The 1/sqrt2

In tau, the same bound follows from the entropy constraint: defect entropy S_def of the final excision must exceed the sum of initial defect entropies by the No-Shrink Theorem.

registry_objects.title: Contrast with fractal cosmologies
registry_objects.summary: The Finite Motif Theorem excludes fractal cosmologies: there is no infinite hierarchy of self-similar patterns at arbitrarily large or small scales. The motif count stabilizes at a finite value. The universe has a finite structural alphabet with no infinite descent or ascent.

registry_objects.title: Saturation radius vs. observable universe
registry_objects.summary: The saturation radius R_sat is a structural property of tau^3, while the observable universe is a chart-level concept. R_sat is comparable to the observable universe size, meaning what we can see is essentially everything there is in terms of structural variety.

registry_objects.title: No infinite hierarchy
registry_objects.summary: The Absorbing Pattern Theorem precisely negates "turtles all the way down": no infinite tower of ever-larger structures contains our observable universe, and no infinite descent of ever-finer structures exists below the Planck scale. The pattern converges -- the universe is finite in both directions.

registry_objects.title: What the chain does NOT prove
registry_objects.summary: The four-theorem chain proves structural finiteness (finitely many types of structure in a convergent pattern) but not quantitative finiteness (exact counts of galaxies, stars, or BHs). The chain establishes the universe is a finite book in a finite alphabet without determining the page count.

registry_objects.title: Not a Big Crunch
registry_objects.summary: The shrinking coherence horizon resembles the Big Crunch but is structurally different: no recollapse to infinite density/curvature occurs. Excisions grow but remain well-defined topological features, the boundary layer stays finite, and no infinite density is reached. The endstate is a pattern, not a singularity.

registry_objects.title: Generative does not mean explosive
registry_objects.summary: The generative phase includes the Big Bang, inflationary, threshold-ladder, and conventional astrophysical epochs -- all are generative because new motif types appear. The refinement phase sees no new structure types, only mergers, cooling, and approach to the absorbing pattern.

registry_objects.title: Epochs are structural, not anthropic
registry_objects.summary: The three-epoch decomposition is structural, not anthropic: it depends on whether the boundary holonomy algebra H_partial[omega] at depth n supports modes with sufficiently distinct frequencies to constitute a clock, which is a mathematical property of the spectral structure, not a statement about observers.

registry_objects.title: Late-stage conditions favor complexity
registry_objects.summary: Late refinement-phase conditions (finite temperature, stable patterns, no disruptive motif creation) are precisely those favoring emergence and persistence of complex structures. The generative phase is turbulent; the refinement phase is stable and predictable -- an optimal habitat for life. Scope: conjectural.

registry_objects.title: Not the anthropic principle
registry_objects.summary: This is not the anthropic principle ("universe has these parameters because we observe it"). Tau says the progression operator drives the absorbing pattern toward a stable, warm, structured configuration that structurally attracts life. Life is a structural consequence, not a selection effect.

registry_objects.title: The key difference: no infinity
registry_objects.summary: Both heat death (infinite time) and Big Crunch (infinite density) involve infinities. The tau endstate involves none: proper time is finite, temperature bounded below, density bounded above, entropy bounded. Eternal circulation is a finite, stable, warm, structured steady state.

registry_objects.title: Scope note: CMB predictions C2, C5, C6
